nodes.label: cavemem_offload move
nodes.rationale: Moves a heavy recurring context block into cavemem so it is recalled compactly instead of re-pasted every session; applied only when a measured net-token-negative gate and a working recall path both hold, and reverted otherwise so removing context never outpaces the ability to recall it.

nodes.label: net-token-negative gate
nodes.rationale: An applied fix is only kept if a re-measure shows tokens/turn strictly decreased; otherwise the edit is reverted. Exists to stop caveman-learn from claiming savings it has not actually measured.
